FOUND s497b: Pl/t/misc-fixes-01.t's UNIVERSAL::isa row PASSED ON A BUG -- the `my $a` let is closed at the `package D;` section boundary (`:why :exception-global`), the statements after `package main;` read `main::$a` (the global, undef), and ref() of that undef box answered ARRAY because p-ref's array arm tested (listp nil).  s497b fixed p-ref (consp), so the row now fails honestly; it is in a TODO block naming this task.

REPRODUCER (perl 5.40.3 vs PCL):
    my $a=[1]; package D; package main; print ref($a), "|\n";
  perl: ARRAY|     PCL: |
A lexical with any other name works (`my $x`), so it is the $a/$b sort-variable special case (the exception-global partition) meeting the section split.
BAR: the misc-fixes-01.t TODO row passes; a guard row with $a and $b; corpus-diff.
